mapper.select:
select f.facility_no , f.facility_ty_cd , f.instl_dt , f.facility_nm , f.apt_cmplex_no , f.dong_no , f.loc_cn , f.use_yn , f.file_group_no , cc.code_name as facility_ty_nm , lf.chk_dt as latest_fault_dt , lf.chk_ty_cd as latest_fault_ty_cd , case when mh.facility_no is not null then 'Y' else 'N' end as meter_linked_yn from facility f
left outer join common_code cc on cc.group_code_no = 'FACILITY_TY' and cc.code_no_cd = f.facility_ty_cd
left outer join ( select fch.facility_no , fch.chk_dt , fch.chk_ty_cd from facility_check_hstry fch where fch.chk_stts_cd = 'FAULT'
and fch.chk_dt = ( select max(fch2.chk_dt) from facility_check_hstry fch2 where fch2.facility_no = fch.facility_no and fch2.chk_stts_cd = 'FAULT' ) ) lf on lf.facility_no = f.facility_no
left outer join ( select distinct facility_no from meter_hstry ) mh on mh.facility_no = f.facility_no where f.apt_cmplex_no = (
select mo.apt_cmplex_no from mgmt_office mo where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} )
and ( lower(f.facility_no) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(f.facility_nm) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(f.loc_cn) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' )
and f.facility_ty_cd = #{facilityTyCd}
and f.use_yn = #{useYn}
and (f.dong_no is null or f.dong_no = '')
and f.dong_no = #{dongNo}
order by f.facility_no desc

select count(distinct f.facility_no) as disabled_total , count(distinct case when trunc(fch.mdf_dt) = trunc(sysdate) then fch.facility_no end) as disabled_today from facility f
left outer join facility_check_hstry fch on fch.facility_no = f.facility_no and fch.chk_stts_cd = 'FAULT' where f.use_yn = 'N' and f.apt_cmplex_no = ( select apt_cmplex_no from mgmt_office where mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} )
select * from attach_file where file_group_no = #{fileGroupNo} order by file_sort_order, reg_dt
select distinct dong_no , dong_nm from apt_unit where apt_cmplex_no = ( select apt_cmplex_no from mgmt_office where mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo} ) and dong_no is not null order by dong_no
